title: Prepare queued-send burst performance characterization
completion_notes: Implemented the additive queued-send performance control, campaign, manifest, package authorization, runner, bounded evidence, result generator, deterministic replay, requirement-home tests, and SpecTrace records. The exact eight-block / 16-job campaign completed on independent hosts plab-worker-x64-02 and plab-worker-x64-03 from clean source 5bd4b4d2ddbb027bee534392dca2a2518f8fa935 with zero failed attempts, zero request failures, zero timeouts, and no detected saturation. A separate activation preflight produced 19,455 legal-budget activations before timing. Canonical result 1c02b545e1714079fc12f6f46bba502c5f5c661dbf5883a2591774cbfe9979 records eight rows per cell and 779,800 total bytes of bounded server output. legacy_current averaged 26.9473 requests per second and 46.7691 ms p95; single_datagram averaged 1.7960 requests per second and 596.1500 ms p95. The observed single_datagram treatment was worse in every block, but the result remains characterization-only: no winner, performance acceptance, adaptive rule, active behavior, production activation, or covering-array generation was authorized.
out_of_scope: Deleting retained failed or retried evidence
summary: Author an exact two-cell queued-send performance slice with deterministic eight-block timing, package-backed ProtocolLab execution, a preflight stream-throughput gate, resumable bounded evidence, and a descriptive non-promoting result.
verification_plan: Validate the new SpecTrace JSON, prove the campaign compiles to exactly eight two-position blocks and 16 jobs, prove the gate workload must establish predicate.queued_send.legal_budget_gt_one before accepted single_datagram timing rows, run focused Release builds and targeted tests, verify package-backed ProtocolLab execution preserves resumability and bounded aggregate evidence, and confirm that performance acceptance, rule derivation, active behavior, and production activation remain false.
planned_changes:
- Add a queued-send performance campaign manifest and descriptive result control set.
- Add deterministic compiler, runner, preflight gate, and result-materialization scripts for the two-cell queued-send family.
- Bind the single_datagram timing acceptance to the quic.transport.stream-download.1mb gate proving predicate.queued_send.legal_budget_gt_one.
- Preserve resumability, bounded aggregate evidence, and exact job identity across retries.
- Keep adjacent axes fixed at legacy_current and keep all acceptance and activation booleans false.
